# Game Idea: Gravity Runner

A simple side‑scroll canvas game where the player controls a ball that constantly falls under gravity. Use left/right arrows to move and jump on moving platforms while avoiding spikes. Lose if the ball hits a spike or falls off the bottom of the screen. Survive as long as possible as platform speed gradually increases.

<content>
1: // Simple Gravity Runner game
2: // Canvas element with id="game" is expected in the HTML.
3: // The player is a ball that falls under gravity, can move left/right
4: // and jump on moving platforms while avoiding spikes.
5: 
6: (() => {
7:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
8:   if (!canvas) {
9:     console.error('Canvas with id "game" not found');
10:     return;
11:   }
12:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
13:   const W = (canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800);
14:   const H = (canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600);
15: 
16:   // ---- Sound Setup ----
17:   const AudioContext = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
18:   const audioCtx = new AudioContext();
19:   // jump sound
20:   const jumpBuffer = audioCtx.createBuffer(1, audioCtx.sampleRate * 0.1, audioCtx.sampleRate);
21:   const jumpData = jumpBuffer.getChannelData(0);
22:   for (let i = 0; i < jumpData.length; i++) {
23:     jumpData[i] = Math.sin(i / 10) * Math.exp(-i / jumpData.length);
24:   }
25:   // hit sound
26:   const hitBuffer = audioCtx.createBuffer(1, audioCtx.sampleRate * 0.2, audioCtx.sampleRate);
27:   const hitData = hitBuffer.getChannelData(0);
28:   for (let i = 0; i < hitData.length; i++) {
29:     hitData[i] = Math.random() * 0.5 * Math.exp(-i / hitData.length);
30:   }
31:   function playBuffer(buf) { const src = audioCtx.createBufferSource(); src.buffer = buf; src.connect(audioCtx.destination); src.start(); }
32:   function playJump() { playBuffer(jumpBuffer); }
33:   function playHit() { playBuffer(hitBuffer); }
34:   // resume on interaction
35:   function resumeAudio(){ if (audioCtx.state==='suspended') audioCtx.resume(); window.removeEventListener('keydown', resumeAudio); window.removeEventListener('mousedown', resumeAudio); }
36:   window.addEventListener('keydown', resumeAudio);
37:   window.addEventListener('mousedown', resumeAudio);
38: 
39:   // Game constants
40:   const GRAVITY = 0.5;
41:   const JUMP_VEL = -10;
42:   const PLAYER_RADIUS = 15;
43:   const PLAYER_SPEED = 4;
44:   const PLATFORM_SPEED = 2;
45:   const PLATFORM_WIDTH = 100;
46:   const PLATFORM_HEIGHT = 20;
47:   const SPIKE_SIZE = 20;
48: 
49:   // Input state
50:   const keys = { left: false, right: false, up: false };
51:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
52:     if (e.code === 'ArrowLeft') keys.left = true;
53:     if (e.code === 'ArrowRight') keys.right = true;
54:     if (e.code === 'ArrowUp' || e.code === 'Space') keys.up = true;
55:   });
56:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => {
57:     if (e.code === 'ArrowLeft') keys.left = false;
58:     if (e.code === 'ArrowRight') keys.right = false;
59:     if (e.code === 'ArrowUp' || e.code === 'Space') keys.up = false;
60:   });
61: 
62:   const player = {
63:     x: W / 2,
64:     y: H - PLAYER_RADIUS - 1,
65:     vx: 0,
66:     vy: 0,
67:     onGround: false,
68:   };
69: 
70:   // Platform constructor
71:   let platformSpeed = PLATFORM_SPEED; // mutable speed
72:   function Platform(x, y, w = PLATFORM_WIDTH, h = PLATFORM_HEIGHT) {
73:     this.x = x;
74:     this.y = y;
75:     this.w = w;
76:     this.h = h;
77:     this.vx = -platformSpeed; // move left
78:     this.update = function () {
79:       this.x += this.vx;
80:       // recycle when off screen
81:       if (this.x + this.w < 0) this.x = W;
82:     };
83:     this.draw = function () {
84:       // Platform gradient shading
85:       const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(this.x, this.y, this.x, this.y + this.h);
86:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#777');
87:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#333');
88:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
89:       ctx.fillRect(this.x, this.y, this.w, this.h);
90:     };
91:   }
92: 
93:   // Spike constructor (simple triangle)
94:   function Spike(x, y, size = SPIKE_SIZE) {
95:     this.x = x;
96:     this.y = y;
97:     this.size = size;
98:     this.vx = -PLATFORM_SPEED;
99:     this.update = function () {
100:       this.x += this.vx;
101:       if (this.x + this.size < 0) this.x = W;
102:     };
103:     this.draw = function () {
104:       ctx.fillStyle = '#a00';
105:       ctx.beginPath();
106:       ctx.moveTo(this.x, this.y + this.size);
107:       ctx.lineTo(this.x + this.size / 2, this.y);
108:       ctx.lineTo(this.x + this.size, this.y + this.size);
109:       ctx.closePath();
110:       ctx.fill();
111:     };
112:   }
113: 
114:   // Generate initial platforms, spikes, and stars
115:   const platforms = [];
116:   const spikes = [];
117:   const stars = [];
118:   for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
119:     const pX = i * (W / 4) + W;
120:     const pY = H - 100 - i * 80;
121:     platforms.push(new Platform(pX, pY));
122:     // Add a spike on some platforms
123:     if (i % 2 === 0) {
124:       spikes.push(new Spike(pX + PLATFORM_WIDTH / 2, pY - SPIKE_SIZE));
125:     }
126:   }
127:   // Create star field
128:   for (let i = 0; i < 50; i++) {
129:     stars.push({
130:       x: Math.random() * W,
131:       y: Math.random() * H,
132:       r: Math.random() * 2 + 1,
133:     });
134:   }
135: 
136:   let gameOver = false;
137:   let frame = 0;
138: 
139:   function update() {
140:     if (gameOver) return;
141:     // Horizontal movement
142:     player.vx = 0;
143:     if (keys.left) player.vx = -PLAYER_SPEED;
144:     if (keys.right) player.vx = PLAYER_SPEED;
145:     // Jump
146:     if (keys.up && player.onGround) {
147:       player.vy = JUMP_VEL;
148:       player.onGround = false;
149:       playJump();
150:     }
151: 
152:     // Apply gravity
153:     player.vy += GRAVITY;
154: 
155:     // Update position
156:     player.x += player.vx;
157:     player.y += player.vy;
158: 
159:     // Keep inside horizontal bounds
160:     if (player.x - PLAYER_RADIUS < 0) player.x = PLAYER_RADIUS;
161:     if (player.x + PLAYER_RADIUS > W) player.x = W - PLAYER_RADIUS;
162: 
163:     // Collision with platforms (simple AABB check)
164:     player.onGround = false;
165:     for (const p of platforms) {
166:       // Only check when falling
167:       if (player.vy >= 0) {
168:         const withinX = player.x + PLAYER_RADIUS > p.x && player.x - PLAYER_RADIUS < p.x + p.w;
169:         const abovePlatform = player.y + PLAYER_RADIUS <= p.y && player.y + PLAYER_RADIUS + player.vy >= p.y;
170:         if (withinX && abovePlatform) {
171:           player.y = p.y - PLAYER_RADIUS;
172:           player.vy = 0;
173:           player.onGround = true;
174:         }
175:       }
176:     }
177: 
178:     // Spike collision (point inside triangle approximation using bounding box)
179:     for (const s of spikes) {
180:       const withinX = player.x > s.x && player.x < s.x + s.size;
181:       const withinY = player.y + PLAYER_RADIUS > s.y && player.y - PLAYER_RADIUS < s.y + s.size;
182:         if (withinX && withinY) {
183:           playHit();
184:           gameOver = true;
185:         }
186:     }
187: 
188:     // Fall off bottom
189:     if (player.y - PLAYER_RADIUS > H) gameOver = true;
190: 
191:     // Update platforms and spikes
192:     for (const p of platforms) p.update();
193:     for (const s of spikes) s.update();
194:   }
195: 
196: function draw() {
197:     // Background gradient (already drawn in cleared area)
198:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
199:     const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
200:     bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#222');
201:     bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#555');
202:     ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
203:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
204: 
205:     // Stars
206:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
207:     for (const star of stars) {
208:       ctx.beginPath();
209:       ctx.arc(star.x, star.y, star.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
210:       ctx.fill();
211:     }
212: 
213:     // Draw player with radial gradient
214:     const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(player.x, player.y, PLAYER_RADIUS*0.3, player.x, player.y, PLAYER_RADIUS);
215:     grad.addColorStop(0, '#8f8');
216:     grad.addColorStop(1, '#0a0');
217:     ctx.fillStyle = grad;
218:     ctx.beginPath();
219:     ctx.arc(player.x, player.y, PLAYER_RADIUS, 0, Math.PI * 2);
220:     ctx.fill();
221: 
222:     // Draw platforms
223:     for (const p of platforms) p.draw();
224:     // Draw spikes with gradient shading
225:     for (const s of spikes) {
226:       const spikeGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(s.x, s.y, s.x, s.y + s.size);
227:       spikeGrad.addColorStop(0, '#f44');
228:       spikeGrad.addColorStop(1, '#a00');
229:       ctx.fillStyle = spikeGrad;
230:       s.draw();
231:     }
232: 
233:     // Game over overlay
234:     if (gameOver) {
235:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
236:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
237:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
238:       ctx.font = '48px sans-serif';
239:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
240:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', W / 2, H / 2);
241:     }
242:   }
243:   }
244: 
245:   function loop() {
246:     if (!gameOver) {
247:       update();
248:     }
249:     draw();
250:     frame++;
251:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
252:   }
253: 
254:   // Start the game loop
255:   loop();
256: })();

(End of file - total 256 lines)
</content>
